narrative: On the part. Egeon's roll on a bench, the name at the top, the opening speeches below it out of the frame. On the part. A short note in the margin, in his hand, beside the place where the wife is lost. No speech copied out.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the margin note and went on to open the play.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
entities.context: Shown on part in Egeon, and then idle
